"Sea-salt morning. You got the last starter, lucky kid."
"The professor's expecting you. Don't keep her standing around."
"Grab a relic before the gate. First route's rougher than it looks."
"Whole town fits on a postcard. We remember who left and who came back."
"That house by the water has its lights on again. Nobody's seen who lives there in years."
"Watch the tall grass past the fence. Small things in there, big opinions."
"Quarry shift just let out. The gym's where they wash the dust off."
"The Leader tests your stamina, not your luck. Heal up first."
"Mart's open all night. Potions don't carry to the next run, so spend them."
"Dust gets into everything here. Your boots, your lungs, your win record."
"Free to watch the dojo. Costs plenty to step on the mat."
"The house at the quarry's edge stays unlocked. Nobody locks it. Nobody goes in."
"Every barista in this town can recite a movepool. It's a little much."
"The Tutor knows tricks no school teaches. Bring gold and a good memory."
"They say the Dojo Master boxed a Machamp once. Don't test it."
"Bring a notebook. The Tutor talks fast and won't repeat for free."
"The cafés argue type charts till closing. Stay out of it near the gym crowd."
"Kid down the lane keeps a list of every trainer who comes through. Swears she's seen your name before."
"Students run mock leagues in the quad. Lose to a freshman and they'll publish it."
"The Nature Rater keeps office hours. Make an appointment like everyone else."
"Half these textbooks are wrong by next year. The Gym Leader isn't."
"Lectures run late. So do the rematches out back."
"There's a library shelf nobody reshelves. Take what you find, leave what finds you."
"Freshmen post your losses, seniors post your wins. Pick your rivals early."
"Ranger boots, hunter boots, poacher boots. Every kind of mud meets at this gate."
"The Safari Zone takes your money and your patience. Sometimes it pays back."
"Don't catch what you can't train. The Underground buys what you can't keep."
"Past the gate it's mud and waiting. The Zone doesn't bargain."
"Rangers count everyone in and everyone out. Usually the numbers match."
"Don't name what you might have to release. Costs you more that way."
"Half the badges in this town were won at the slots. Don't ask which half."
"Casino payouts are real. The odds are realer."
"You can hear the Gym Leader from the rooftop bar. She likes a crowd."
"Last easy night before the climb. Spend it or don't, the slots don't care."
"Fountain shuts off at midnight. Some nights it runs anyway. Maintenance, they say."
"Win big and the floor remembers your face. Lose big and so does the alley."
"This city eats trainers and prints champions. Take notes."
"Department Store sells what you need. The alley sells what you don't."
"Colress is on the top floor and hates waiting. Move quick."
"Twelve floors of want, a roof lab, and an alley for everything between."
"Colress studies you whether you agreed to it or not. Mind which questions you answer."
"The square's big screen loops the same champion's walk-on. Same face, long as anyone bothers to remember."
"Thin air at the pass keeps the tourists down in the lowlands."
"Veterans drink here between rematches. Buy a round, get a story."
"League gates open at dawn and close on the unworthy."
"Thin air, thinner patience. You can almost taste the League from up here."
"Every story at this altitude is a warning wearing a smile."
"Somebody walks the pass at night who shouldn't be able to. Wears a cap like yours. The veterans stopped pointing it out."
"Last gym before the Plateau. People travel weeks just to lose here."
"The bells ring for every challenger. They don't ring twice."
"A masked figure was asking after you. Wouldn't leave a name."
"Bells, pilgrims, one last gate. Past it the cities run out."
"The masked one came through again. Asked the bell-keeper how you were doing. By name."
"Take the long look back. Six routes made you. The seventh won't be a route."
"This is the room. No badges past that door, only legacies."
"Cameras are rolling. Smile or don't. It's your face."
"Welcome to the Plateau. Try not to flinch."
"Different currency past this door. Legacies, not badges."
"The portrait wall has one empty frame at the end. Clean glass. Nobody ever books it."
"Cameras love a flincher. Don't give them the shot."
"This is it. The road goes one way from here, and not back."
"Nerves are just the body admitting you care."
"The gate opens for the worthy. The rest learn to read it."
"One way in. This road forgot how to turn around a long time ago."
"Bring everything. The road keeps whatever you can't carry."
"People hear a second set of footsteps in here. Always one behind. Always keeping pace."
"Trainers still gather here, even after the credits rolled."
"Hall of Fame's right over there. Your name should still be on it."
"The Underground broker's been asking about you. Quietly."
"Credits rolled and nobody left. Tells you something about the worthy."
"The broker's questions got sharper since you took the wall. He smiles more, too."
"Your name's on the Hall. Go look. Some mornings folks swear the date beside it reads wrong."
